label: eero Pro 6E
description: Wi-Fi 6E tri-band mesh router, 2x2 on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz (AXE5400 class); the 6 GHz band carries both clients and mesh traffic, so there is no dedicated backhaul radio. Two auto-sensing ports per unit, one 2.5GbE and one 1GbE, so a 2.5G wired backhaul is possible on the primary node.
